REM ###########################################################################################
REM #                                                                                         #
REM # Title     : Linux Forensic Triage Collector                                              #
REM # Author    : NullSec (bad-antics)                                                         #
REM # Version   : 1.0                                                                         #
REM # Category  : incident-response                                                            #
REM # Target    : GNU/Linux                                                                    #
REM #                                                                                         #
REM ###########################################################################################

REM Description: Collects volatile forensic artifacts from a Linux system during
REM incident response. Captures running processes, network connections, open files,
REM logged-in users, recent authentication logs, cron jobs, and bash history.
REM All data is saved to a timestamped report file for offline analysis.
REM
REM This payload does NOT require root privileges for basic collection.
REM For enhanced collection (auth logs, full process details), run with sudo.

DELAY 3000
CTRL-ALT t
DELAY 1500

REM Create the triage collection script
STRING cat << 'NULLSEC_EOF' > /tmp/.nullsec_ir_triage.sh
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING #!/bin/bash
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # NullSec Linux Forensic Triage Collector v1.0
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING REPORT_DIR="/tmp/nullsec_ir_$(hostname)_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING mkdir -p "$REPORT_DIR"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING REPORT="$REPORT_DIR/triage_report.txt"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "============================================" > "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo " NullSec Forensic Triage Report" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo " Host: $(hostname)" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo " Date: $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo " Uptime: $(uptime -p 2>/dev/null || uptime)" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "============================================" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # Section 1: System Information
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "[*] Collecting system information..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "=== SYSTEM INFO ===" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING uname -a >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING cat /etc/os-release >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # Section 2: Currently Logged-In Users
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "[*] Collecting logged-in users..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "=== LOGGED-IN USERS ===" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING who -a >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "--- Last logins ---" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING last -n 20 >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # Section 3: Running Processes (volatile!)
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "[*] Collecting running processes..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "=== RUNNING PROCESSES ===" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING ps auxwwf >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # Section 4: Network Connections (volatile!)
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "[*] Collecting network connections..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "=== NETWORK CONNECTIONS ===" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING ss -tulnp >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "--- Established connections ---" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING ss -tnp state established >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "--- ARP table ---" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING ip neigh show >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "--- Routing table ---" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING ip route >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "--- DNS config ---" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING cat /etc/resolv.conf >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # Section 5: Open Files
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "[*] Collecting open files..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "=== OPEN FILES (network) ===" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING lsof -i -n -P 2>/dev/null | head -100 >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # Section 6: Scheduled Tasks
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "[*] Collecting scheduled tasks..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "=== CRON JOBS ===" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING crontab -l >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "--- System cron ---" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING ls -la /etc/cron* >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING cat /etc/crontab >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "--- Systemd timers ---" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING systemctl list-timers --all >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # Section 7: Recent File Modifications
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "[*] Checking recently modified files..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "=== FILES MODIFIED IN LAST 24H (sensitive dirs) ===" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING find /etc /tmp /var/tmp /dev/shm -type f -mtime -1 2>/dev/null >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # Section 8: Shell History
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "[*] Collecting shell history..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "=== BASH HISTORY ===" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING cat ~/.bash_history >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # Section 9: SSH Configuration
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "[*] Checking SSH artifacts..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "=== SSH AUTHORIZED KEYS ===" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING cat ~/.ssh/authorized_keys >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "--- SSH known hosts ---" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING cat ~/.ssh/known_hosts >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING # Section 10: Loaded Kernel Modules
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "[*] Collecting kernel modules..."
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "=== LOADED KERNEL MODULES ===" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING lsmod >> "$REPORT" 2>&1
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "" >> "$REPORT"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "[+] Triage complete! Report saved to: $REPORT_DIR/"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING echo "[+] File listing:"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING ls -la "$REPORT_DIR/"
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING NULLSEC_EOF
ENTER
DELAY 500

STRING chmod +x /tmp/.nullsec_ir_triage.sh && bash /tmp/.nullsec_ir_triage.sh && rm -f /tmp/.nullsec_ir_triage.sh && exit
ENTER
